newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca to review options after Busang.
newsitem.headline: Minorca to review options after Busang.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc said on Tuesday it will review all options available after a report revealed that the Busang project is worthless.
Minorca said it is "to review all alternatives available to the company to maximize shareholder value following the recent announcements with respect to its investment in the Busang project."
Minorca said it has retained RBC Dominon Securities Inc as financial adviser to assist in the review.
An independent consultant's report released by Bre-X Minerals Ltd late on Sunday revealed that samples from Busang had been tampered with on a large scale.
Minorca shares were down 0.99 at 0.95 on the Toronto Stock Exchange in turnover of 4.21 million shares.
